text.tspan: G9 Frametop Together: the units, a room and its links, away, voices, shared panels, control, pointers, gaze, moving, avatars (cda8438, branch dee-193-together)

g.text: Together on this Frame (together/run.sh, frametop-together.service, the eight frametop-room-* units PartOf it)
The session on one Frame (session.h Mode, G9Together.tla)
A link at the owner's end (session.cpp Link::State)
A guest's links (session.cpp OnHello, Knocked, Mesh, OnRoom)
Your voice and mouth (ft-roomvoice sender.cpp, mouthsay.h, local/mouth.h)
A screen of yours in the room (ft-roompanels keeper.py, screens/share.c, ft-sharepanel)
Someone's panel here (keeper.py _others, remote.c peer, ft-peerpanel, flow/video.h)
The avatar someone has on (flow/looks.h, local/wardrobe.h, avatar/room/sentbody.h)
Your avatar for the others (wardrobe.cpp Wear, roomavatar.py, ft-model-import --allow-share)
A panel of yours and someone in the room (flow/control.cpp, room/grants.h: your ft-together decides)
The turn on your desktop (room/desk.h, local/inputs.h, ft-roominput giver.py, screens/peerinput.h)
Your hand on someone's panel (ft-peerpanel, local/panelhand.h, local/hush.h, control.cpp Act)
Where you look, for the room (local/gaze.h, gazeask.h, ft-roomgaze feeder.py)
The others' marks on a panel here (ft-roompoints: points/marks.h, dots.h, local/glances.h)
You in the room (roompanels/moving.py, gliding.py, ft-roommove puller.py, grab.py)
Someone's panel in your hand (roompanels/carrying.py, flow/moves.h, local/moveask.h)
